story.iWant: a PdfIngestionService that can load PDFs and render pages as images at a configurable DPI
story.soThat: downstream components have a reliable source of page images and basic document structure
story.tasks: T1: Choose and integrate a PDF library (confirm or adjust use of pdfplumber). T2: Implement load_pdf(input: Union[str, bytes]) -> PdfDocument in an ingestion module. T3: Implement render_page(page_index: int, dpi: int) -> PageImage with basic validation and defaults. T4: Add tests for loading, rendering, and error conditions using a small PDF fixture. T5: Update requirements and docs to reflect PdfIngestionService as the ingestion entrypoint.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. PdfIngestionService exposes load_pdf(input: Union[str, bytes]) -> PdfDocument using core models. 2. PdfIngestionService exposes render_page(page_index: int, dpi: int) -> PageImage with configurable DPI. 3. Invalid paths and out-of-range page indices raise clear, descriptive errors. 4. Tests cover success and failure paths and run via pytest without errors. 5. Requirements and configuration reflect the chosen PDF library with reasonable defaults.

story-context.constraints: - Keep PdfIngestionService focused on loading and rendering only; do not mix in table detection or OCR. - Use project-relative paths and avoid hard-coded absolute paths. - Prefer pure-Python configuration (e.g., default DPI constant) over external config files for this story.

tests.standards: Use pytest for unit and integration tests, following the existing pattern in tests/test_models.py. Keep tests fast and deterministic, using small local PDF fixtures.
tests.locations: - tests/ - tests/fixtures/ (for sample PDFs, if added)
tests.ideas: - AC1: Test load_pdf on a valid small PDF fixture and assert PdfDocument.page_count and PdfPage geometry. - AC2: Test render_page on page 0 at a default DPI and assert non-null image object and expected type/dimensions. - AC3: Test load_pdf with a missing file path and assert that a descriptive exception is raised. - AC3: Test render_page with an out-of-range page index and assert that a descriptive exception is raised.
